    EditorActivityListener
    Receives BlueJ editor document changes and records text-change events, including active and idle editing intervals.
    EditorTracker
    Tracks open BlueJ Java editors and attaches document listeners so text edits can be recorded as telemetry events.
    TelemetryCollection
    Stores the telemetry events captured during a recording session and provides safe access to a copy of the list.
    TelemetryEvent
    Represents one timestamped telemetry event and its optional compilation, execution, editor-activity or class metadata.
    TelemetrySession
    Records the start and end of a telemetry session and calculates its elapsed duration in seconds.
